children: Vext Science reopened its Jackson, Ohio dispensary and agreed with certain holders to extend approximately $6.0M in APP seller notes to January 15, 2029, subject to conditions and expected effective October 1, 2026.
Restores Ohio retail revenue stream; near-term sales and traffic can resume.
Removes a 12/31/2026 balloon maturity, easing refinancing risk.
Pushing out a large near-term cash call supports liquidity.
Timing guides when balance sheet relief would start.

This extends prior Ohio build-out while managing near-term debt and store operations. A sustained traffic rebound in Jackson and formal completion of the note restructuring would turn this into a clearer catalyst.
